method.text: cosine of all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings (ai.vectors.embed) of title + objective + approach + keywords
method.conditions: cosine of z-scored features: fuel phase (one-hot), hardware family (one-hot), flight/ground, relevance tier, tested O2 / ln(pressure) / airflow midpoints and spans with missing flags
method.map: metric MDS (sklearn, random_state=0) on distance = 1 - combined similarity
method.clusters: agglomerative clustering, average linkage, precomputed distance; k in 3..7 chosen by silhouette
method.labels: computed: dominant fuel phase and hardware family of the members + keywords over-represented in the cluster vs the rest (title + keywords, unigrams and bigrams)
